rows.vgi.doc_llm:
## `sample_templates`

A **browsable table** (no arguments) listing the DOCX templates the worker ships, so an agent can render a real document without supplying a file. One row per bundled template:

- `name` (`VARCHAR`) -- logical template name, e.g. `sample_invoice`.
- `path` (`VARCHAR`) -- the absolute filesystem path to pass as the `template` argument of `docgen_render` / `docgen_merge`.
- `field_count` (`INTEGER`) -- how many placeholder fields the template has.
- `fields` (`VARCHAR`) -- the comma-separated `{{ placeholder }}` names; these are exactly the keys the `STRUCT` data argument must provide.
- `description` (`VARCHAR`) -- what the template is for.

Read `path` and `fields` from this table, then call `docgen_render(path, {field: value, ...})` to produce a document.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
# `sample_templates`

Registry of the DOCX templates bundled with the worker, so you can render a real document out of the box.

## Columns

- `name` (`VARCHAR`) -- logical template name.
- `path` (`VARCHAR`) -- absolute path to pass as the `template` argument.
- `field_count` (`INTEGER`) -- number of placeholder fields.
- `fields` (`VARCHAR`) -- comma-separated placeholder names to supply as data.
- `description` (`VARCHAR`) -- what the template is for.

Look up a template's `path` and `fields` here, then feed them to `docgen_render` or `docgen_merge`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description": "List every bundled template with its path and the placeholder fields it expects.", "sql": "SELECT name, path, fields FROM docgen.main.sample_templates ORDER BY name"}, {"description": "Count how many document templates the worker ships out of the box.", "sql": "SELECT count(*) AS template_count FROM docgen.main.sample_templates"}]
